name: MACD momentum
description: Enter when MACD crosses its signal line in the direction of the longer trend.

about.how_it_works: MACD is the gap between a fast and a slow moving average. When it crosses above its own signal line, momentum is turning up. The 100-bar EMA filter keeps it to trades in the direction of the bigger trend.
about.fails_when: Momentum signals lag: in quiet markets MACD crosses often and most crosses go nowhere.
